==Description==
'''Werewolf Commander''' is an exclusive sticker obtained from the [[Null & Void Event]]. It was obtained from Level 23 of the regular track, which had a cost of {{GumDrops|590}} or {{Robux|85}} to unlock, with a total cost of {{GumDrops|6,270}} or {{Robux|1,363}}. Prior to the 20% discount, it had a cost of {{Robux|107}} to unlock, with a total cost of {{Robux|1,716}}.

==Appearance==
'''Werewolf Commander''' showcases the {{Color|Null|Werewolf}} [[Commander]] howling at the moon. It plays a howl sound when used.
